info.title: Language Academy curriculum API
info.summary: Catalog, lesson content, words, Word of the Day, content review and catalog releases.
info.description: Edge function `curriculum`. Domain document: build-spec/domains/curriculum.md. Shared pieces come from common.openapi.json; rules from build-spec/00-conventions.md.

get.description: The catalog version now published: units, lessons, guides, readings, steps with minute estimates and access tiers, stories, and the key map from prototype step ids, live section ids and position keys to stored keys. The same for every learner; holds no lesson text. Clients cache it by catalog_version.
A published or retired version still inside its acceptance window, for a client that opened a step on it. A version outside the window returns gone.

Words, phrases, exercise items and step bodies of one lesson at one content revision. Steps the caller may not open (identity svc_can_access) come back locked, with an empty body and only the free preview (OPS-4). Without content_revision the revision in the published catalog is returned.
Display data for up to 200 word ids, for review cards. Unknown ids are left out of the list.

get.summary: Get the Word of the Day for a date
get.description: The published Word of the Day for the learner's local date. Only items in status published are ever returned (AI-1). A date more than one day after the server's UTC date is refused.
A published content item by id, for links from email. A withdrawn item returns gone.
Staff queue of content items by status, kind and publish date, ordered by publish_date then item_id.

post.description: Creates a draft written by staff. Automatic checks run at once and are stored on the item.

get.summary: Get a content item with its review history
get.description: The item at its current content revision, its checks and every review decision.

put.description: Replaces the body and date, creating a new content revision and rerunning the checks. An approved item goes back to in_review, because the approval was for the old revision. Published, withdrawn and rejected items cannot be edited (conflict); withdraw and create a new item instead.

post.description: draft to in_review. Refused with curriculum.checks_failed while any automatic check fails.

in_review to approved, for the content revision the reviewer read. The reviewer must hold the reviewer role (identity svc_has_role, SEC-9) and must not be the last editor of that revision (curriculum.self_review_not_allowed). Writes an audit entry.
in_review to rejected, which is final. The date is free for another item. Writes an audit entry.

post.summary: Send a content item back to draft
post.description: in_review to draft with a note. Writes an audit entry.

post.summary: Publish an approved content item now
post.description: approved to published ahead of the automatic publish job, which publishes approved items 48 hours before their date.
approved or published to withdrawn. Messaging stops every unsent message that uses it. Writes an audit entry.

get.description: Every catalog version with its status, newest first.

post.description: Stores a la-bundle@1 bundle (contracts/curriculum.bundle.schema.json) as the next catalog version in draft and runs validation. A bundle that fails the schema is stored with the problem bundle_invalid and nothing else. The body cap for this operation is 10 MB.

201.description: The draft release with its validation report and diff.

get.description: One release with validation problems and its diff against the published version.

post.description: draft to in_review. Refused with curriculum.release_invalid while validation has problems.

in_review to published; the previous published version becomes retired and stays readable for its acceptance window. The publisher holds the reviewer role and did not create the release. Writes an audit entry.
draft or in_review to discarded. The version number is never reused.

CurriculumMeta.description: Meta (C-API-3) plus the catalog version now published, so a client learns of a new release on any response.

LessonKind.description: Kind of a catalog entry. Prototype kind 'help' is 'guide'; prototype kind 'exam' is 'unit_exam'.

counted.description: Counts toward lesson completion and minutes. False for Soon steps.

soon.description: Shown as Soon; cannot be opened or completed (Conversation today).

pass_pct.description: Set for exams (80). A finish below it is outcome failed.

position.description: Order inside the unit, guides included. Used only for routes and display (C-ID-3).

position_key.description: Route key 'U.N' for this catalog version only.

display_number.description: The number shown as 'Lesson N'. Equal to position for every kind, guides included (guide rows add a Guide tag).

title.description: French parts marked with braces, as in 'Essential Verb · {être} (to be)'.

minutes.description: Sum of estimate_minutes over counted steps.

guide_after_module_key.description: For a guide, the lesson it follows in the list.

can_do.description: What the learner can do after this entry, shown on the Lesson complete screen and in emails; French marked with braces. Empty for entries without one.

after_text.description: Can-do sentence: 'After this unit you can ...'.

StepAliases.description: Published key map. Keys outside this map are never stored or sent (DATA-1).

legacy_positions.description: Live app position to module_key, frozen from the live app's main branch at commit e4392e7. The client uses it only to open old /lessons?module=N links and never stores or sends the number (DATA-1).

cover.description: Path of the cover image under the static stories folder.

units.description: Every unit in display order. The number of units and the last unit come only from this list.

routes.description: position_key to module_key for this version, e.g. {"1.3": "2024-01-02-etre"}.

accepted_versions.description: Catalog versions the progress API still accepts attempts for.

text.description: French spelling. Display only; never a key (DATA-7).

review.description: True for a word taught in an earlier lesson and shown again here as an example, as in a lesson that teaches only grammar. Vocabulary Intro shows it tagged Review; it does not count as a word learned in this lesson and does not enter review from this lesson.

parts.description: Parts with a reviewed tip each (AI-2). Empty when no part tip has been reviewed; the step then works with the phrase's reference text and its general tip.

tip.description: General tip, labelled as general when shown (AI-2).

item_id.description: Unique inside its module_key and stable across content revisions while the question keeps its meaning. The same item_id may appear in Writing and in the lesson exam; it is one question with one answer key.

answer_key.description: Sent for instant feedback; the server grades again (C-LAY-4). One item has one answer key in every step it appears in.

section_id.description: A step of the entry, or reference-content for a Reference page's text, which is not a step and carries no progress.

locked.description: True when the caller may not open this step; body and items are then empty (OPS-4).

body.description: Shape set by section_id: vocabulary-intro holds VocabularyIntroBody, a Reference page's reference-content part holds ReferenceBody, interactive-help holds guide parts and checks, reading-passage holds story blocks. Empty when locked.

preview.description: For locked steps only: the free preview carried in the release bundle (a guide's first part, a reading's first picture and the two text blocks after it). Curriculum stores and serves it; identity's access rule decides who sees the full step.

LessonContent.description: Content of a catalog entry or a Reference page at one content revision.

WordOfTheDayBody.description: Validated on import and on every edit (AI-1).

last_edited_by.description: Staff id of the last editor; null when the body is the AI draft unchanged.

RevisionPin.description: The content revision the reviewer read. A decision on any other revision is refused with version_mismatch.

severity.description: error blocks submitting and publishing; warning is listed for the reviewer and blocks nothing.

bundle.description: A la-bundle@1 document: units, entries with their steps, the Reference shelf, words, stories, content with items, phrases and previews, the placement form, retired keys and the frozen legacy position table. Up to 10 MB.

ContentKind.description: Kind of anything with lesson content: a catalog entry (LessonKind) or a Reference page on the shelf ('reference'). Reference pages carry no progress.

ShelfPage.description: A Reference page on La Référence, outside the numbered units. It has no steps and carries no progress.

screen.description: A page with its own screen. Until that screen is built, the client shows the page's text and tables like any other Reference page.

ShelfManifest.description: La Référence. Guides are linked by their own module_key, in course order, and never copied.

TypedAnswerKey.description: A typed item with one answer.

language.description: Language of the expected answer. fr: the shared answer checker applies French normalization (accents, elision, spacing). en: English normalization, for meaning items whose answer is English.

accept.description: Every accepted answer; the first is the one shown as correct.

mistakes.description: Named wrong answers with their explanation. None of them may pass the checker.

BlanksAnswerKey.description: A gap-fill with one or more blanks. prompt.text holds one ___ marker per blank, in order; the checker grades each blank and the item is right only when every blank is.

language.description: Language of the expected answer. fr: the shared answer checker applies French normalization (accents, elision, spacing). en: English normalization, for meaning items whose answer is English.

mistakes.description: Named wrong answers with their explanation. None of them may pass the checker.

Named wrong answers for the whole item, matched against every blank's answer joined with one space after normalization, such as je ne sais pas typed for ne ... pas. Per-blank mistakes stay on each blank. None of them may pass the checker.

PairAnswerKey.description: Speed Match: which left card goes with which right card.

AnswerKey.description: Stored answer key of an exercise item (la-bundle@1). typed and story_question items use TypedAnswerKey or BlanksAnswerKey, choice and guide_check items ChoiceAnswerKey, pair items PairAnswerKey. A guide check's key marks the right choice for feedback; guide checks add no miss.

ConceptBlock.description: A grammar card. Text is English with French marked with braces.

block_id.description: Unique inside its module_key and frozen once written (C-ID-4).

TableBlock.description: A conjugation table or another two-column table of French and English.

block_id.description: Unique inside its module_key and frozen once written (C-ID-4).
Unique inside its module_key and frozen once written (C-ID-4).

VocabularyIntroBody.description: Body of the vocabulary-intro step. The words come from LessonContent.words; blocks are the lesson's concept cards and tables, in display order. No progress is stored for a block.

ReferenceBody.description: Body of a Reference page's reference-content part: sections and tables, in display order. The page's word table is LessonContent.words.

ItemPrompt.description: What the learner sees for one exercise item (la-bundle@1). French is marked with braces in every text field. Fields an item kind does not use are absent or null.

text.description: The question line. A typed item with several blanks holds one ___ marker (three or more underscores) per blank.

en.description: English shown with the question, such as the phrase to write in French.

context.description: A scene line shown before the question.

hint.description: Shown when the learner asks for a hint.

sub.description: A second line under the question.

audio_text.description: French read aloud for a listening question.

shown_fr.description: French shown on screen for the learner to look at.

sound.description: The sound spelled for English readers, such as lay zon-fon.

explain.description: Shown after the learner answers, right or wrong.

left_label.description: Speed Match: heading over the left column.

right_label.description: Speed Match: heading over the right column.

IfNoneMatchCatalog.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatchCatalog.description: Tag of the copy the client holds; a current tag gets 304 with no body.

IfNoneMatchContent.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatchContent.description: Tag of the copy the client holds; a current tag gets 304 with no body.

CacheControl.description: private, max-age=300 for the catalog; private, max-age=86400 for a lesson content revision.

x-error-codes.meaning: The caller last edited this content revision, or created this release; another reviewer must decide.
An automatic check fails on this content revision; details.checks lists them.
The release has validation problems; details.problems lists them.
Another item of this kind and language is approved or published for that date.
